title: Look Up a Team
instructions:
Write a function called `lookupTeam` that takes two parameters: `teams` of type `Map<Int, String>` and `number` of type `Int`.

If the team number exists in the map, return the team name. If it does not exist, return the string "Unknown".

For example:
- `lookupTeam(mapOf(4215 to "Tribots"), 4215)` returns `"Tribots"`
- `lookupTeam(mapOf(4215 to "Tribots"), 9999)` returns `"Unknown"`
hint: Use `teams[number]` to look up the value. If the key is not found, it returns `null`. You can use the `?:` operator (called the Elvis operator) to provide a default: `teams[number] ?: "Unknown"`.
